name: Light-Mode Data HUD
summary: A near-white cockpit of sixteen hairline micro-panels; a teal scanline sweeps it and corner brackets snap onto the one wrong number.
look: Terminal density in Swiss calm: hairline-ruled micro-panels with mono counters and sparklines on warm white, top and bottom ticker rails, focus brackets. Only teal (watching) and coral (anomaly) carry colour.

motion.name: Odometer digits
motion.how: per-digit steps(10) roll 0.6 s, final value power4.out on the downbeat

motion.name: Scanline sweep
motion.how: 960 px in 1.2 s linear, panels brighten as it passes, one sweep per 2 bars

motion.name: Rack focus
motion.how: others blur 0 to 6 px while the camera eases in 1.1x over 0.8 s, brackets snap on the snare

story: Hook: a blurred cockpit of 16 green panels with a bracketed plate: '38 dashboards. All green. Almost.' Reveal: a teal scanline sweeps across, panels tick green behind it, and the Acme Pulse plate appears at the centre. Proof: rack focus onto the checkout conversion panel, 2.80% and −18% with the 09:42 deploy marker, coral brackets, then a card offering Roll back or Acknowledge. CTA: the grid ghosts out behind a plate with the lockup, 'Every metric. Every minute.' and Start free.
adapt: Fill the panels with your own KPIs, make the hero panel the number your product protects, and keep scanline plus brackets as the 'product is watching' device.

fit.risk: density is unreadable at feed size; hold one panel hero-sized per beat
